The '''Lumbridge Swamp shed''' is a seemingly inconspicuous storage shed located at the heart of the swamp, east of the mysterious runes for the [[water altar]]. Entering the shed can only be done on [[members]] worlds, and entering without wielding either a [[Dramen staff]] or [[Lunar staff]] will simply allow the player to enter the building. However, while wielding either of the staves, the player will be teleported to the entry fairy ring of [[Zanaris]]. 

There are [[frog]]s, [[big frog]]s, and [[giant frog]]s as well as [[giant rat]]s that spawn outside the shed.

As the shed is not too far from the entrance of the [[water altar]], it can be a point of travel for [[Runecraft]]ing [[water rune]]s by using a bank near a [[fairy ring]], teleporting to Zanaris through that fairy ring and then heading to the entry fairy ring that exits out to the shed, then heading  to the mysterious ruins.

==Features==
* There is an inconspicuous hole just outside of the shed for an easy-level [[STASH]] unit.
* There is a pair of [[tools (gardening)|tools]] that the player can take to obtain a [[rake]] and a [[spade]].
